content: {"episode_id":"ep-05031","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome, consistent with diagnosis codes I48.0 and I49.5. The note further cites a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), for which continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management. On these documented grounds we request reconsideration of the denial and payment of the outstanding balance of 718.5."}
